title: NCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 - 1,607 Vacancies, Apply Opens June 1 via NATS/NAPS Portal
author: Ash K.
summary: Northern Coalfields Limited (NCL) released apprentice recruitment notification for 1,607 vacancies across Graduate, Diploma, ITI Trade, and Paramedical disciplines. Application opens June 1, 2026 - last date June 15. Apply via NATS portal (Graduate/Diploma) or NAPS portal (ITI Trade). Only candidates from UP or MP institutions eligible. Merit list June 20. Stipend: ₹12,300/month for graduates.
body: Northern Coalfields Limited (NCL), Singrauli, has released the NCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 notification (Advt. No. NCL/HRD/CETI/2026-27/168) for 1,607 apprentice vacancies across Graduate, Diploma, ITI Trade, and Paramedical disciplines for FY 2026-27. The application window opens June 1, 2026 - today - and closes June 15, 2026. There is no written exam - selection is purely merit-based on qualifying exam marks.

DetailInformation
Total Vacancies1,607 Apprentice posts
Application OpensJune 1, 2026 (today)
Last Date to ApplyJune 15, 2026
Merit List ReleaseJune 20, 2026
Training Duration1 Year under Apprentices Act, 1961
Age Limit18–26 years (relaxation for reserved categories)
State RestrictionQualification must be from UP or MP institution only
Selection ProcessMerit (qualifying exam marks) → Document Verification → Medical Test
Graduate Stipend₹12,300/month (Govt share via DBT)
Apply Portal (Graduate/Diploma)NATS - nats.education.gov.in
Apply Portal (ITI Trade)NAPS - apprenticeshipindia.gov.in
NCL Official Websitenclcil.in → Career → Apprenticeship Training

Category-wise vacancies: The 1,607 posts are divided across four categories - Graduate Apprentice (B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc degree holders), Diploma Apprentice (diploma in engineering), Trade Apprentice (ITI passed), and Paramedical Apprentice Trainees (nursing, lab technician etc.). For discipline-wise breakup (Electrical, Mechanical, Mining, Civil, Computer Science, Electronics, Commercial, and more), refer to the official notification PDF on nclcil.in.

Critical eligibility condition - UP/MP institution only: Only candidates who completed their qualifying degree, diploma, or ITI from an institution located in Uttar Pradesh or Madhya Pradesh are eligible. Candidates who studied in other states - even if they are domicile of UP/MP - are NOT eligible. This is the single most important eligibility filter.

How to apply - two portals: Graduate and Diploma candidates must first register on the NATS portal (nats.education.gov.in), get their Enrollment ID, then fill the NCL application. ITI Trade candidates register on the NAPS portal (apprenticeshipindia.gov.in) for their Enrollment ID. After getting the Enrollment ID, fill the NCL application with academic details, marks percentage, category, and upload photo and signature. Only one application per candidate - multiple applications lead to disqualification. No offline/paper applications accepted.

No written exam - marks matter most: There is no written test or interview for NCL Apprentice 2026. The merit list is prepared strictly in descending order of marks scored in the qualifying examination. Candidates with higher percentage have a direct advantage. The provisional merit list releases June 20. Selected candidates are then called for document verification and medical test as per Mines Rules, 1955. See our RRB NTPC guide for railway recruitment, or Seekho Kamao Yojana for another skill training opportunity.

faqs.question: When does NCL Apprentice 2026 application open?
faqs.answer: NCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 application opens June 1, 2026 and closes June 15, 2026. Graduate and Diploma candidates apply via NATS portal (nats.education.gov.in). ITI Trade candidates apply via NAPS portal (apprenticeshipindia.gov.in).

faqs.question: How many vacancies are in NCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: NCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 has 1,607 vacancies across Graduate Apprentice, Diploma Apprentice, Trade Apprentice (ITI), and Paramedical Apprentice Trainee categories for FY 2026-27.

faqs.question: Is NCL Apprentice 2026 open for all states?
faqs.answer: No. Only candidates who completed their qualifying degree, diploma, or ITI from an institution in Uttar Pradesh or Madhya Pradesh are eligible. Candidates from other states cannot apply even if they are UP/MP domicile.

faqs.question: What is the stipend for NCL Apprentice 2026?
faqs.answer: Graduate Apprentices receive ₹12,300/month. Diploma Apprentices receive a lower stipend as per Apprentices Act rates. The government share is paid via DBT. For Trade Apprentices, the stipend is paid entirely by NCL. No accommodation or transport is provided.

faqs.question: Is there a written exam for NCL Apprentice 2026?
faqs.answer: No. NCL Apprentice 2026 has no written examination. Selection is entirely merit-based - candidates are ranked in descending order of marks scored in their qualifying exam. Higher percentage = better chances. Merit list releases June 20, 2026.

faqs.question: What documents are required for NCL Apprentice 2026?
faqs.answer: Degree/Diploma/ITI marksheet and certificate, NATS or NAPS Enrollment ID, Aadhaar card, caste certificate (if applicable), passport-size photograph, and signature. Candidates must get their NATS/NAPS Enrollment ID before applying on the NCL portal.

callout.heading: Application Opens Today - Don't Miss June 15 Deadline
callout.content: NCL Apprentice 2026 application window opens June 1 and closes June 15 - just 15 days. Get your NATS or NAPS Enrollment ID first (Graduate/Diploma → nats.education.gov.in | ITI → apprenticeshipindia.gov.in), then apply on nclcil.in. No written exam - your degree/ITI marks decide selection.
